description: This file defines the CompatibilityDirectorManager class, responsible for managing compatibility strategy directors within the Orleans runtime, including retrieving, setting, and resolving version directors based on configurations and interface types.

classes.name: CompatibilityDirectorManager
classes.description: Manages different implementations of ICompatibilityDirector based on interface types and strategies, allowing dynamic configuration of compatibility strategies.

methods.name: CompatibilityDirectorManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the manager with dependency injection, setting up default strategies and directors.

methods.name: GetDirector
methods.description: Returns the director for a specific interface type, or the default if none is set for that type.

methods.name: SetStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default or specific interface type's compatibility strategy and updates the associated director.

methods.name: ResolveVersionDirector
methods.description: Private static method that resolves and returns an ICompatibilityDirector based on the provided strategy.
